thread:
ana: Heads-up: customer asked why their traffic fell back to a smaller model during a canary. Console just shows 'fallback' and their product team is confused.

pierre: Oof. We need clearer language when a fallback is intentional vs auto. Suggest statuses: AUTO_FALLBACK, OPERATOR_OVERRIDDEN, CANARY_PROMOTE, SAFETY_QUARANTINE.

tom: UX: show a pill with color + tooltip. e.g. AUTO_FALLBACK -> yellow with "automatic policy: soft-fail v2". OPERATOR_OVERRIDDEN -> purple with who/when.

alix: Also add a reason code that maps to docs. Codes small: TF (timeout), RL (rate limit), OOM, Q (quality regression), S (safety). Clicking code opens docs page with k8s logs grep snippet.

ana: typo - ana: @alix docs snippet is good. But exposing too many codes in UI is noise. Maybe codes visible in expanded view only.

deploy-bot: :bell: patch-note: new telemetry keys added to event-store: fallback_status, fallback_code, decision_id.

pierre: We also need better chronological audit for rollouts: show a timeline per rollout with all fallback events, model switches, operator interventions. Helps with postmortems.

tom: Agree. Timeline should be downloadable as CSV for compliance audits.

alix: Accessibility: the pill color must have text label too (avoid color-only).

ana: Edge-case: what about chained fallbacks (A -> B -> C)? Console should render nested arrows: redwood-xl -> redwood-small -> redwood-tiny with timestamps.

pierre: For nested events, decision_id chain should reference parent_decision_id. Good for graphing.

tom: Implementation: store parent_decision_id optional field. Frontend can fetch event graph by decision_id and render mini-graph inline.

alix: Can we include a link to the exact model artifact digest used? e.g. model: redwood-lite@sha256:abcd. Helps debugging when variants have same name.

ana: Security: the digest is safe. But double-check private model URIs not leaked.

pierre: I'll prototype the timeline component in Figma. Tom/Alix, can you add an API endpoint to fetch eventgraph? endpoint: GET /api/rollouts/:id/eventgraph?limit=50

tom: Yep. Will stub. Also add caching layer for hot rollouts.

ana: Tests: integration test to replay a canary with induced 503s and assert the timeline shows three fallbacks, parent-child links and CSV export.

deploy-bot: :rocket: staging flag: "rollout.timeline" enabling UI + api endpoints. Rolling out to internal first 2026-03-26.

ana: Thanks. I'll write the spec and link to Figma. Tagging @support for message templates to share with customers.

pierre: Nice. One last thing: include a "what changed" diff for route config in timeline (eg concurrency limit lowered from 256 -> 64). Helps root-cause.

tom: Good call. We'll surface config deltas in timeline entries.

alix: Done. We'll iterate on microcopy after prototyping.
